sentenceIntentions.text: A dying man receives a machine that speaks with his younger voice.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Introduce an intimate uncertainty around Kazi's identity
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel curiosity about a familiar voice coming from an unauthorized machine

sentenceIntentions.text: A Balance of Iron and Salt begins with a delivery he never authorized.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the novel and establish the uninvited delivery
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand this is a domestic science-fiction opening

sentenceIntentions.text: Around him, technology has made daily life safer and resources easier to share.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Place the household inside successful technological coordination
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel the appeal of a safer civilization

sentenceIntentions.text: Yet its citizens still argue, make things by hand, and insist on saying no.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Give citizens ordinary agency and eccentricity
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize people rather than a generic dystopian population

sentenceIntentions.text: The novel brings these freedoms into a household where care and control become difficult to separate.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Bring care and control into the same home
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Wonder how benevolent help might overstep

sentenceIntentions.text: A physician, a blacksmith, and a former persuader see different dangers in the same promises.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Introduce conflicting professional and personal perspectives
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect disagreement with human reasons on several sides

sentenceIntentions.text: Their arguments make this future feel warm, strange, and close to home.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Make the speculative world emotionally approachable
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Anticipate warmth as well as unease

sentenceIntentions.text: Step through Kazi’s doorway, where even a familiar voice cannot tell you whom to trust.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Return to Kazi's threshold without revealing the machine's purpose
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to discover which promises deserve trust
